h:
将图像转变为提示的简单工作流程。

可以使用

  • Qwen3.5。如果您想要一个不拒绝请求的未经审查的 Qwen3.5 版本，将自行下载所需的模型（节点的功能），寻找“HauhauCS-Aggressive”
    较小的模型似乎在遵循“生成重现 Illustrious 中的角色的提示”时遇到问题。命令。

  • WD14 标记器。经典之作，至今仍然运作良好。模型也可以在 Use 上下载。也是 Node 的一个功能。

  • 某些版本附带 Easy-Use 节点集。还没找到那个的用途。

  • Florence 2。 Florence 2 可以做很多好事。标记图像、描述图像、屏蔽图像。试一试吧！模型端的最大新令牌似乎设置为 1024。至少当我尝试 2048 时，它发出嘶嘶声并冻结了我的系统。大于 3 的 num_beams 确实需要一些重要的资源。无法在 6900XT 16GB vram 和 64GB 系统 RAM 上运行。至少它在大约30分钟内没有完成。我推荐基本型号。 Ft 的意思是微调，但...不知道这实际上意味着什么。基本模型工作正常。 SDPA 的关注速度相当快，因为​​我没有 nvidia 卡，所以无法测试其他卡。

o.en:
Simple Workflow that turns Images to Prompts.

Can use

  • Qwen3.5. Will download the required model by itself (feature of the node) if you want a uncensored version of Qwen3.5 that doesnt refuse requests look for "HauhauCS-Aggressive"
    Smaller models seem to have issues to follow the "Generate a Prompt to reproduce the character in Illustrious." command.

  • WD14 Tagger. A classic and still works remarkably well. Models also get downloaded on Use. Also a feature of the Node.

  • Some Version that comes with the Easy-Use node set. Havent found a use for that one.

  • Florence 2. Florence 2 can do so many nice things. Tag images, describe images, mask images. Just give it a spin! max new tokens seems to be set to 1024 on model side. at least it threw a hissi fit and froze my system when i tried 2048. num_beams bigger than 3 really wants some serious recources. cant run it on 6900XT 16GB vram and 64gb system ram. at least it didnt finish in roughly 30min. I recomend the base model. Ft means fine tuned but... no idea what that ACTUALLY means. base model works fine. sdpa attention is decently fast and since i dont have a nvidia card i cant test the other ones.
